content.short: Sablier provides by-the-second token streaming protocol for Web3 payments used by DAOs and businesses.
content.description: With Sablier, time equals money. Users monitor real-time crypto earnings in the Sablier dashboard. For Web3 organizations, a one-time deposit triggers smart contracts to stream tokens to recipients automatically, removing the need for recurring distributions.
content.meta: Sablier enables token streaming each second for Web3 payments used by DAOs & businesses. Discover Sablier and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
